item.title: More Than 200 Students from Across Louisiana Compete in 25th Annual McGrath Math Competition at LSMSA (2026-11-20)
item.description: More than 200 students representing 16 schools from across Louisiana gathered at the Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts (LSMSA) on Nov. 19, 2026 for the 25th Annual McGrath Math Competition.
